The finitely generated direct summand K is zero by Nakayama, hence f is an isomorphism. The cited Bourbaki II§3no.2, cor.2 of prop.5 keeps A/J a field as a standing assumption; finite presentation and nilpotence are its additional alternatives. Finite projectivity already gives finite presentation here. Delete the unsupported nilpotence disjunct from the example, without changing the lemma’s actual hypothesis.
